label: Parity: a feature-uniform demand for a reason why excludes a brute contingent truth
description: The parity argument, brute-contingent form: a stance-level consistency result. Valid by a short derivation (the demand is transferred by uniformity, then met); all its weight is on P1-P3. It lowers the standing of the brute-contingency rival only for stances holding all three; it is not support for B2. Each member of the bundle is deleted by a named stance in the parity map. Establishes no premise.
